features.name: age_center_distance_norm
features.description: Absolute standardized distance of x001 from its training-fold center, scaled to a bounded 0.0-1.0 coordinate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps the age-like axis on a unit scale and makes distance from a central prototype explicit for nearest-neighbor matching.

features.name: hours_center_distance_norm
features.description: Absolute standardized distance of x013 from its training-fold center, scaled to a bounded 0.0-1.0 coordinate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps weekly-effort variation comparable to other engineered coordinates and separates unusually low or high effort patterns.

features.name: attainment_center_distance_norm
features.description: Absolute standardized distance of rank-like x005 from its training-fold center, scaled to a bounded 0.0-1.0 coordinate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable rank-distance coordinate without letting the raw x005 scale dominate Euclidean neighborhoods.

features.name: log_weight_range_position
features.description: Log-range normalized position of x003 between observed training-fold bounds, clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew in x003 and maps it to a bounded coordinate, improving scale balance for distance search.

features.name: resource_activity_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled total activity in x011 and x012, normalized by the combined observed upper bounds and clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights sparse but meaningful resource activity while keeping zeros close together and large values compressed.

features.name: resource_balance_signed_unit
features.description: Bounded signed balance between log-scaled x011 and x012, shifted to 0.0-1.0 where 0.5 represents near balance or no activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates gain-heavy and loss-heavy resource patterns on a bounded axis suitable for KNN geometry.

features.name: worklife_center_l2_norm
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised center in standardized x001, x005, and x013 space, divided by a training-fold upper scale and clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a compact distance-to-prototype coordinate for rows with similar age, rank-like attainment and effort structure.

features.name: coded_profile_center_l2_norm
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised center across encoded fields x002, x004, x006, x007, x008, x009, x010, and x014, standardized and clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an unsupervised distance-to-center cue across encoded categorical-style fields, helping KNN group central versus unusual code patterns.

features.name: generic_center_similarity
features.description: Inverse-distance similarity to a generic unsupervised prototype combining standardized x001, x005, x013, and log-positioned x003.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a bounded similarity score to a generic central prototype, adding an attraction coordinate for dense regions.

features.name: central_work_pattern_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for a dense central work-pattern band using x001, x005, and x013 thresholds chosen from unsupervised ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a hard cluster cue for a common central work pattern so nearby rows share a local geometry anchor.

features.name: workstage_semantic_affinity
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 semantic score assigned from x001, x005, and x013 that rates how coherent the life-stage, rank-like attainment, and weekly effort appear together; 0.0 is unusual within training-fold ranges and 1.0 is highly coherent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth semantic neighborhood coordinate for rows with similar work-stage meaning, complementing exact numeric gaps.

features.name: coded_role_semantic_coherence
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 semantic score for the joint row pattern of x002, x004, x006, x007, x008, x009, x010, and x014; higher values indicate the code combination appears internally consistent and typical relative to training-fold code ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses multiple encoded status and role fields into one distance-friendly cue, reducing fragmentation from sparse code combinations.
